name: Haus Mary
beschreibung:
Overview

The Haus Mary of the Hechenberger family is a small, cosy bed-and-breakfast with an apartment in a central location in Söll in the Wilder Kaiser region of Tyrol. The accommodation is located in Dorf 27, just a few minutes' walk from the village centre, and offers a view of the Hohe Salve and the Wilder Kaiser. Guests stay in sunny and quiet surroundings and reach the village centre of Söll in around three minutes on foot.

The accommodation comprises three cosy guest rooms, each equipped with shower/WC, cable TV and hairdryer, as well as a non-smoking apartment with balcony. The apartment has a kitchenette with dishwasher, microwave, cooker with oven and coffee machine; towels and bed linen are provided. A cosy breakfast and lounge room is available to guests. A breakfast buffet is served in the morning.

History/Background

The house is run as a family business and bears the name Haus Mary – Fam. Hechenberger; Anna Maria Hechenberger is named as the contact person. No further, verifiable history of the business is available in the sources used here, so speculation is deliberately avoided.

Getting there

Coming from the direction of Kufstein, the journey leads via the B173 towards St. Johann; after about ten kilometres, turn off onto the B178 towards Söll. At the roundabout take the first exit, turn sharp right as far as the fire station, turn left into the village and after about 50 metres you reach the fourth house on the right-hand side. Coming from the direction of Wörgl, drive along the B178 to the Söll roundabout, take the third exit and turn left into the village at the fire station. A large car park is available directly at the house. The ski bus stop is right at the house, and the village centre is around 100 metres away.

Tips

For winter sports enthusiasts there is a ski room with a ski boot dryer; a sauna and an infrared cabin are available for an extra charge. The garden with a pond, garden house and model railway, as well as a barbecue area, invite you to relax. On request, guests of the apartment are offered fresh bread rolls in the morning. Wi-Fi and free parking are available. The Ahornsee bathing lake is around 500 metres away, the Hexenwasser about 800 metres.

Best time to travel

The house is located in the Wilder Kaiser holiday region and near the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental, as well as on hiking and cycling trails. No specific seasonal recommendation emerges from the sources used; the accommodation is advertised for both winter and summer stays.
